Unison UI for macOS 0.6.1

Version 0.6.1 is a small user-interface and update-infrastructure release on top of 0.6.0. Existing profiles and settings continue to work without migration.

Fixed

  • The reconcile toolbar no longer shifts between phases. After a scan finished, the Go button used to move to where another control had been, because a single button was relabelled and resized per phase. The toolbar is now spatially stable: every button keeps its position, so Go stays where you expect it.

Changed

  • Stop is a sync-only control. The Stop button keeps its "Stop" label and its position in every phase, and is active (red) only while a synchronization is running, when it aborts that sync. During a connect or scan it is inactive. To return to the profile list at any time, including during a scan, use Profiles (or ⌘⇧P). Leaving during a scan does not cancel it; the scan continues in the background. If it does not finish, quit and relaunch the app. Rescan is disabled while a scan or sync is already running.
  • Update checks now go through updates.courbage.net. Builds from 0.6.1 onward check for updates through a project-run proxy rather than contacting GitHub Pages directly. It serves the same signed appcast byte-for-byte, so update integrity is unchanged and a signed feed is still required.

When anonymous system-profile sharing is enabled, the project records a bounded per-check telemetry row containing the shared profile fields and coarse country, subject to the documented retention period. When sharing is disabled, the project creates no telemetry record, although Cloudflare still processes the request as the hosting provider. No IP address, user agent, cookie, or user identifier is stored. See what data the app sends in the FAQ.

Compatibility

  • No profile or settings migration is required. Same system requirements as 0.6.0: macOS 15 or later, Apple Silicon.
  • The move to updates.courbage.net takes effect for update checks made by this build and later. A 0.6.0 install discovers 0.6.1 through its existing feed; once 0.6.1 is installed, its later checks use the new address.
  • If automatic update checking is enabled, Sparkle notifies you when 0.6.1 is available; whether it then downloads and installs automatically or only after you confirm depends on the separate automatic-download choice from the first-launch prompt. You can also update any time from App menu ▸ Check for Updates.

Unison UI for macOS 0.6.0

Version 0.6.0 is a safety, correctness, and robustness release on top of 0.5.1. Existing profiles and settings continue to work without migration.

Safety

  • Archive maintenance is crash-safe. Clean Stale Archives, Reset Archives, and archive recovery now run as a single locked transaction: they take the same per-archive lock a live Unison uses, stage everything, and only then move the removed set to the Trash as one unit. Before the removal is committed, any failure rolls back the staged files; a crash is detected on the next launch and recovered — restoring the files if it had not yet committed, or finishing the removal if the whole set was already committed — with the locks released only after you confirm no other Unison is running.
  • Clean Stale Archives only offers provably superseded copies. Orphans, "probably old" copies, anything involving a remote replica, and any archive whose roots can't be read unambiguously are now shown for reference only, never selectable and never preselected.
  • The manual installer (install.sh) is safer. It installs atomically, so a failed install can never leave you without a working app, verifies that the download quarantine was actually cleared, and accepts only a Release build. (Homebrew-cask installs are unaffected.)
  • Fixed a rare crash or corrupted results at the end of a sync, caused by values in the end-of-sync snapshot moving under the garbage collector before they were read.
  • "Rescan Ignoring Archives…" can no longer overlap in-flight work. It runs only from a ready state, so it can't start on top of a connection, scan, or sync already in progress.

Fixed

  • Editing a profile preserves a symlinked .prf. Saving no longer replaces a symlinked profile (for example one linked from a dotfiles repository) with a regular file, and it keeps the file's comments, ordering, and escaping intact.
  • A profile the app can't read is protected. An unreadable or non-UTF-8 .prf is not opened as an editable empty form, so a Save can't overwrite it with a blank profile.
  • Diffing a file no longer freezes the reconcile window. The window stays responsive while a diff runs; a stalled diff is reported, and other engine actions stay disabled until it returns. If it never does, quit and reopen the app.
  • Ignore and Diff act on the item you mean — the selection from the menu bar, the clicked row from the right-click menu — and Select Conflicts now reveals conflicts hidden inside collapsed folders.
  • No false version warning from an SSH login banner. The remote Unison-version check reads Unison's own version line, so a login banner that mentions a version number no longer triggers a spurious compatibility warning.

Changed

  • Genuinely built for macOS 15. The app and its embedded Unison engine are now compiled for the macOS 15 minimum and verified on macOS 15 before release.

Compatibility

  • No profile or settings migration is required. Same system requirements as 0.5.1: macOS 15 or later, Apple Silicon.
  • If automatic update checking is enabled, Sparkle notifies you when 0.6.0 is available; whether it then downloads and installs automatically or only after you confirm depends on the separate automatic-download choice from the first-launch prompt. You can also update any time from App menu ▸ Check for Updates.

Unison-UI-Mac 0.5.1

Version 0.5.1 is a safety and documentation release on top of 0.5.0. Its main change is how the app behaves when you leave a profile while it is still scanning. Existing profiles and settings continue to work without migration.

Changed

  • Leaving during a scan returns to the profile list without cancelling the scan. While a scan is running, the toolbar's Stop control is Return to Profiles: it takes you back to the profile list but does not stop the scan itself, which finishes in the background. There is no in-place "stop the scan" action. If a remote scan hangs, quit and relaunch the app.

Fixed

  • File-integrity safeguard for interrupted scans. Earlier builds could, in some cases, interrupt a running scan and then keep using the same synchronization engine. Because that engine's internal state could not be verified after a forced interruption, the app no longer does this — protecting your files and Unison's archives is the priority. Ordinary Sync Stop (during an actual file transfer) is unchanged and fully supported.
  • Corrected the built-in Manual and the README so they accurately describe the current behavior — the Settings tabs and menus, the SSH version check and compatibility boundary, and how the app updates itself.

Security

  • Credential prompts default to masked entry. When SSH asks for a password, key passphrase, or verification code, the app now always shows a masked (secure) field; only the exact host-key "are you sure you want to continue connecting (yes/no)?" question uses a plain field. A prompt that merely mentions "authenticity" or yes/no, or a host-key line immediately followed by a password prompt, is treated as a secret and masked — where an earlier build could have shown it in a plain, readable field.

If you are still on 0.5.0

Until you have updated to 0.5.1: if a remote scan hangs, quit and relaunch rather than using Stop Scan followed by Rescan.

Compatibility

  • No profile or settings migration is required. Same system requirements as 0.5.0 (macOS 15 or later, Apple Silicon).
  • If automatic update *checking* is enabled, Sparkle notifies you when 0.5.1 is available; whether the download and install then happen automatically or only after you confirm depends on the separate automatic-download choice from the first-launch prompt. You can also update any time from App menu ▸ Check for Updates.
